description: Maintainer recommendations, separate from generated implementation and live Figma state. New source families default to Needs review.

components:SegmentedControl.reason: Linked items inside a slot; group selection needs a coordinated action.

components:Table.reason: Linked rows/cells plus coordinated column insertion and widths.

components:Flyout.reason: Surface is editable; standard body and footer compositions still need slot mappings.

components:Dialog.reason: Keep the shell and dismissal controls fixed; allow arbitrary forms and actions.

components:Card.reason: Keep framing and defined media/icon parts linked; make content regions flexible.

components:Tabs.reason: Variable trigger count plus associated content. Pairing and active state need validation.

components:Accordion.reason: Repeated linked sections with arbitrary expanded content.

components:Dropdown.reason: Repeat linked items; preserve menu keyboard behavior in code.

components:Select.reason: Options and groups vary; keep the trigger and selected-value rendering fixed.

components:RadioList.reason: Linked option items with exactly one selected item in the design.

components:Tree.reason: Hierarchy and indentation need a tree-specific composition contract.

components:OrderableList.reason: Linked rows can repeat; runtime drag/drop remains in code.

components:Notice.reason: Message and action content can vary inside stable status styling.

components:Tooltip.reason: Support rich tooltip content while preserving the shell; check interactive-content guidance separately.

components:Section.reason: Container styling/layout stays linked while consumer content changes.

components:ScrollArea.reason: Container styling/layout stays linked while consumer content changes.

components:Box.reason: Container styling/layout stays linked while consumer content changes.

components:Flex.reason: Container styling/layout stays linked while consumer content changes.

components:Grid.reason: Arbitrary cells need grid track and span rules; do not treat grid as a plain list.

components:SplitButton.reason: Fixed primary/secondary anatomy; variable menu items belong to Dropdown composition.

components:AssetInput.reason: Source-defined control anatomy or data-driven display; editable properties are the first choice.
